description: This file contains unit tests for elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman (ECDH) key exchange, including test vectors, Wycheproof test integration, and group mismatch tests, using OpenSSL and Google Test frameworks.

methods.name: GetCurve
methods.description: Retrieves an elliptic curve group based on the 'Curve' attribute from a test file.

methods.name: GetBIGNUM
methods.description: Converts byte data from a test file into a BIGNUM object.

methods.name: TestVectors
methods.description: Unit test that runs predefined ECDH test vectors from a file.

methods.name: RunWycheproofTest
methods.description: Runs Wycheproof test vectors for ECDH, verifying correct handling of valid and invalid keys.

methods.name: MakeCustomGroup
methods.description: Creates a custom elliptic curve group with a non-standard generator for testing group mismatch scenarios.
